notes: Going after the unfinished feel. The worst offender was mine: a swipe page was a single app icon floating in an empty grey card, which is placeholder-grade. Each page now takes its colour from the app itself - the icon's dominant colour is sampled and bled softly across the page - so a Waze page looks like Waze and a Spotify page looks like Spotify, instead of every page looking like the same blank card. Icon and title now size themselves from the panel rather than fixed dp, so nothing is lost in the middle of a 13 inch screen, and there is a clear OPEN affordance. The app lists are also built off the main thread now. Rasterising every installed icon and sampling its colour on the UI thread made coming back to home stutter on this deck - it all happens in the background and lands in one go. The Ranger stays as the cropped render for now, as you asked. Send me a photo of this one and I will fix what is actually wrong rather than guessing - I have been wrong twice doing that.
